correctness.rationale: Starting from the exact two-branch boundary parametrization, independent series reversion gives \(1-\rho=\frac32 y^2-\frac{5+3\sqrt3}{2}y^3+K(u)y^4+o(y^4)\), where \(y=1-\gamma\) and \(K(u)=39/2+45\sqrt3/4+16u^3-24u^4\). The cubic coefficient cancels identically on both branches. Since \(u\in[0,1/2]\), \(K\) has cluster interval \([K_0,K_0+1/2]\), so the fourth normalized remainder has no unique limit. Direct substitution into the exact formulas at large integer parameter agrees with the symbolic coefficients.
